rules.accepted_credit_types: Class I (at least 20 hours, may be all 30): courses/seminars provided or approved for CEUs by APTA or its academies/sections (state chapters are not approved providers), FSBPT, APTA Tennessee, or accredited PT/PTA programs; university credit (12 h per semester hour); presenting approved courses (max 20 per topic); adjunct teaching (max 20); advanced degree (26); residency/fellowship (5 h per week, max 26); poster/platform/peer-reviewed article (10 each, max 2); ABPTS specialization (26); peer review of practice; FSBPT-approved activities. Class II (max 10): reading literature (max 1), non-Class-I lectures/posters (max 2), clinical instruction (1 h per 16 contact hours), study group (max 1), in-services (1 h per 8, max 4), professional service (max 4), board meeting (1), APTA membership (1). Not accepted: OSHA/TOSHA, CPR, safety courses. The Board does not pre-approve courses other than ethics/jurisprudence.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure by examination counts as compliance for the initial licensure period, except that 4 hours of ethics and jurisprudence must be completed during the initial period.
rules.audit_note: Licensee attests to completion on the renewal application; all proof must be uploaded into the Board's continuing education vendor platform. Keep documentation 5 years.

topics.who: Ethics and jurisprudence (APTA Code of Ethics, ethical decision making, Tennessee Practice Act and rules, supervision, scope); only courses approved by APTA Tennessee (each at least 2 hours) count; Class I, within the 30 hours

rules.notes: 30 hours in the 24 months preceding the licensure renewal month (renewal due on the expiration date on the licensee's renewal certificate). At least 20 hours Class I, up to 10 hours Class II. Rule compilation revised August 2026.
